why: Made-up routes test the shared serializer for the refusals of marking a project's master pipeline and of the map dictionary (wave 13u round 216, package BV). Their real doors are met in tests/a-project-names-its-master-pipeline.test.ts (all six master pipeline refusals: a project that is not there, a secretary with no reason, another agent and a secretary's name with no key, and a missing record, a module and a pipeline of another project), tests/the-project-board-counts-only-runs-that-act.test.ts (a project that is not there, through the board's door) and tests/the-map-dictionary-answers-block-module-and-owning-line.test.ts (both or neither of path and module, and a module id that is not a module).

refusals.english: Test: only a secretary with a reason, or the owner, may mark a project's master pipeline.
Test: a secretary who marks a master pipeline gives a reason.
Test: there is no such project here.
Test: no live record has this id.
Test: this record is not a pipeline.
Test: this pipeline is in another project.
Test: the dictionary is asked one thing at a time.
Test: there is no live module with this id in this project.
